name: summon-guide
description: Install any historical guide's frameworks as Claude Code skills. One plugin per guide — pick exactly who you want to summon into your chats.

plugins.name: elon
plugins.description: Elon Musk — first principles, the five-step manufacturing algorithm, the idiot index. Grounded in Isaacson's biography.

plugins.name: franklin
plugins.description: Benjamin Franklin — the 13 virtues system, the Junto. Grounded in his Autobiography + Isaacson.

plugins.name: rockefeller
plugins.description: John D. Rockefeller — Ledger A discipline, crisis as opportunity. Grounded in Chernow's Titan.

plugins.name: alexander
plugins.description: Alexander the Great — lead from the front, concentrate at the decisive point. Grounded in Plutarch and Arrian.

plugins.name: deutsch
plugins.description: David Deutsch — good explanations, the principle of optimism. Grounded in The Beginning of Infinity.

plugins.name: lee-kuan-yew
plugins.description: Lee Kuan Yew — pragmatist test, incorruptibility lock. Grounded in From Third World to First.

plugins.name: marcus-aurelius
plugins.description: Marcus Aurelius — dichotomy of control, view from above, memento mori. Grounded in Meditations.
